picks.name: Monster Rounds
picks.annotation: Great item for if getting poked out while clearing waves and for tower diving. Buy first item if getting attacked super hard in lane and stuck behind shop.

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: Very good uber late defensive item. I buy specifically if I'm the solo tank or if my other tank is getting blown up.

picks.name: Witchmail
picks.annotation: Good for against FULL spirit teams, really a necessity buy if pressed for slots. Good against Infernus, Bebop, Geist, Lash etc.

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: Instant gap closer and a disarm, perfect for fliers/Lash since it has crazy range. Rush over Warp Stone if dealing with lots of movers.

picks.name: Juggernaut
picks.annotation: Great counter buy to gun heroes and melee spammers, but on its own won't protect you. AMAZING into Ricochet users.

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: This is what allows your damage to scale late game if they're buying resists, but it is not completely necessary. Very nice against spirit heavy comps. Works best with Spirit Burn.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Late game you're able to proc this with just a Burrow & Scorn so this has some potential as a strong antiheal. Works best with Escalating Exposure.

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: AMAZING active item that gives huge spirit resist, and more AOE damage. Kind of presses you for active slots but well worth it for the extra percentage-based damage.

picks.name: Magic Carpet
picks.annotation: Playstyle choice item, potential as a gap closer and escape tool, but outperformed in both stats by items that specialize in those. Hi Loretze.

picks.name: Arctic Blast
picks.annotation: Good for slow and the fact it completely stops movement and casting movement abilities. Makes proccing Spirit Burn trivially easy. MORE CC IS SUPER GOOD. Use right after ult to counter movement.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: This should literally be the LAST item you buy, like literally full build upgrade kind of item.

picks.name: Transcendent Cooldown
picks.annotation: Buy if you have full active slots since this will lower the cooldown on them.

picks.name: Tankbuster
picks.annotation: Consistent 15% of your damage by end game. Obviously does more damage to higher health targets so prioritize them if just looking for heals. You need 165 Scorn damage to proc this.

754480263.annotation: Bigger Scorns, builds into Greater Expansion later which buffs whole kit.

1998374645.annotation: You'll need T1 Scorn to proc this but thats at 900 souls. Makes your Scorn heal hard try to hit as many targets at once with it.

3399065363.annotation: Much needed speed to rotate and roam, and early hp regen

3074274290.annotation: Overall sprint speed, once you have this you need to be perma-fighting anytime you have Combo up. Alternatively get Enduring Speed if you need slow resist.

1976391348.annotation: Early resist, good damage increase in combination with any ability. Try to use it off cooldown. Builds into Arctic Blast later which is an important interrupt.

395944548.annotation: Large source of your damage and helps with farm, lane clear, and tick dmg overall. Can rush Compress Cooldown here if your ult just went on cooldown.

2603935618.annotation: Good if you just need a cheap antiheal and if no one else is buying it its good to get since they dont stack with other Healbanes.

1439347412.annotation: can buy earlier if u need the regen early

1150006784.annotation: W stamina spam. Arcane Surging Burrow hits full T2 camp. Surge before ult if you can. Do not underestimate the range this gives to your Sandblast. Good alternative to Cold Front, don't buy both.
